description: This file contains functions for processing bounced email messages within the SuiteCRM system, including retrieving error reports, creating campaign log entries for bounces, marking emails as invalid, and identifying bounce-related headers and identifiers.

methods.name: retrieveErrorReportAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves and decodes error report attachments from a bounced email.

methods.name: createBouncedCampaignLogEntry
methods.description: Creates a log entry in the campaign log for a bounced email, marking it as invalid or a send error.

methods.name: markBounceEmailAddressInvalid
methods.description: Marks the email address associated with a bounce as invalid in the system.

methods.name: checkBouncedEmailInvalid
methods.description: Analyzes the email bounce description to determine if the email address should be marked invalid based on SMTP error codes.

methods.name: markEmailAddressInvalid
methods.description: Marks a specific email address as invalid in the system.

methods.name: getExistingCampaignLogEntry
methods.description: Retrieves an existing campaign log entry by target tracker key.

methods.name: checkBouncedEmailForIdentifier
methods.description: Searches the email description for a campaign-specific identifier to link the bounce to a campaign log.

methods.name: campaign_process_bounced_emails
methods.description: Main handler that processes a bounced email, determines if it is relevant, and logs it accordingly.
